thread:
jamie.dev: Heads up — quickstart README (Node) has a token example that uses an env var called REDWOOD_RESPONSE_SCOPE. Folks copy-paste it and immediately hit 403s with 'insufficient_scope'.

sara.docs: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact snippet here? I want to update the README and add a short troubleshooting note.

jamie.dev: Here's the problematic snippet users are copying:
```bash
# BAD (from README)
export REDWOOD_RESPONSE_SCOPE=inference.full
node quickstart.js
```
It looks like someone meant to call out the required scope but used a non-existent env var name. The real workflow is to set an API key that already has the right scopes. Suggested fix:
```bash
# GOOD
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...    # API key that has the inference.full scope
node quickstart.js
```
Also add a short comment about which scopes are required for generation vs embeddings.

kevin-sdk: Nice catch. Another thing — when the SDK receives a 403 due to scope, the current error message is pretty generic ("permission denied"). We should surface something like: "403 Forbidden — token missing required scope (inference.full). See https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#scopes" so users know it's a scope problem and not a network bug. I can throw a tiny PR in the JS SDK to enrich that error.

marco: Repro'd this with a customer in EU — they had a key limited to embeddings only, tried the text-generation quickstart, and got the same 403. They assumed the SDK was broken.

sara.docs: I'll update the quickstart README to replace the bad env var and add a Troubleshooting section with a check command to inspect token scopes: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokens/me` — response shows scopes (e.g., ["inference.full", "embeddings.read"]).

kevin-sdk: Also, let's add a small note about retry behavior: 401/403 should not be automatically retried by client-side retry middleware. That bit caused one of our sample apps to loop on auth failures. I'll add a unit test to ensure retry doesn't run on 401/403.

ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 by sara.docs :white_check_mark:

jamie.dev: Awesome — can we also put a one-line snippet in the README showing how to generate a demo key with the right scopes from the dashboard CLI? Even pseudo-example helps (so customers don't have to assume which scope name to pick).

sara.docs: Will add a short "Create test key" block and call out "inference.full" vs "embeddings.read" with examples. Also adding a callout about not storing server keys in frontend code.

kevin-sdk: I'll open a follow-up issue in the SDK repo to improve the 403 error text and attach a link to the docs change so it's discoverable.

marco: Thanks folks, this should cut down on onboarding support tickets :thumbsup:

jamie.dev: Thanks y'all — leaving a note in the onboarding checklist to verify quickstart examples after doc edits.
